metadata.title: Fluid Tactical Hierarchy for SPARTA Matrix
metadata.goal: Make 9-column SPARTA matrix responsive with accordion/HUD pattern for tablet/mobile
metadata.design_review: Gemini feedback integrated — addresses boss-level 9-column challenge

memory_recall: No prior responsive matrix implementation found in lessons
COTS C02 touch target requirements documented in best-practices-cots
decision_matrix: PostureHUD: CREATE — no existing sticky summary component
TacticAccordion: CREATE — no existing accordion for matrix
TechniqueDrawer: CREATE — Detail panel needs mobile adaptation
FLUID tokens: EXTEND — add to existing EmbryStyle.ts
anti_silo_justification: PostureHUD: No existing sticky HUD in ux-lab; closest is StatusBar but it's not posture-specific
TacticAccordion: No accordion component exists; could use Radix but need SPARTA-specific sparkline integration
TechniqueDrawer: Detail panel is 230 lines; mobile adaptation needs separate component for maintainability

design_principles: 2026 Industrial Elegance: Split-level, blur(32px), interior glow
NVIS Class A: White Phosphor palette, 1.25px strokes
Progressive Disclosure: Z-axis shift on mobile
Semantic Scaling: clamp() for fluid typography
4-Attribute Rule: ALL interactive elements MUST have data-qid, data-qs-action, title, useRegisterAction

test_manifest.visual: HUD shrinks from 48px to 32px ribbon on scroll; expands on scroll-up
9-col at 1200+, auto-fit 3-4 at tablet, single-col at mobile
Accordion headers 44px, sparkline visible, techniques stack vertically
Drawer slides from right, backdrop blur, 44px close button
Cells show only ID + dot; badges/counts hidden; 9-col survives on 13" laptop

tasks.title: Extract PostureHUD as sticky component
tasks.prompt:
Create a sticky Posture HUD that pins at top during scroll.

File: packages/ux-lab/src/components/sparta/shared/PostureHUD.tsx

REFERENCE: /tmp/sparta_evals_mockup.html for progress bar + badge patterns

Extract the posture summary from ThreatMatrix.Header into a dedicated component:
- Shows: satisfied/inconclusive/not_satisfied/no_case counts with glow dots
- Position: sticky, top: 0, z-index: 100
- On scroll (past threshold): shrink to compact "Status Ribbon" mode
  - Ribbon: single row with mini dots + counts only (no labels)
  - Transition: height 48px → 32px with cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)

Use intersection observer or scroll listener to detect shrink threshold.

Integrate into ThreatMatrix.Header — Header delegates posture display to PostureHUD.

4-ATTRIBUTE RULE (REQUIRED):
All interactive elements must have:
- data-qid="posture-hud:element:qualifier"
- data-qs-action="ACTION_NAME"
- title="Tooltip text"
- useRegisterAction hook for keyboard shortcuts

tasks.title: Add fluid typography with clamp()
tasks.gate: N/A — utility tokens, no visual dependency
tasks.prompt:
Update EmbryStyle.ts to use CSS clamp() for fluid typography.

File: packages/ux-lab/src/components/sparta/common/EmbryStyle.ts

Add fluid scale tokens:
```typescript
export const FLUID = {
  techLabel: 'clamp(0.625rem, 0.8vw + 0.4rem, 0.875rem)',  // 10px → 14px
  tacticHeader: 'clamp(0.5rem, 0.6vw + 0.3rem, 0.75rem)',  // 8px → 12px
  cardPadding: 'clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 12px)',
  gridGap: 'clamp(8px, 1vw, 16px)',
}
```

tasks.title: Convert Grid to CSS auto-fit minmax
tasks.prompt:
Update ThreatMatrix.Grid to use responsive CSS grid.

File: packages/ux-lab/src/components/sparta/shared/ThreatMatrix.tsx

Change gridTemplateColumns from fixed to responsive:
- >= 1200px: 9 columns (full tactical spread)
- 768px - 1199px: auto-fit 3-4 columns
- < 768px: single column stack

Use useMediaQuery hook or window.matchMedia.

tasks.title: Create TacticAccordion component
tasks.prompt:
Create TacticAccordion for mobile/tablet view (<1024px).

File: packages/ux-lab/src/components/sparta/shared/TacticAccordion.tsx

REFERENCE: /tmp/sparta_evals_mockup.html for collapsible accordion patterns

Architecture:
- 9 collapsible sections (one per tactic)
- Header: Tactic name + Posture Sparkline (mini bar chart)
- Expanded: Technique list in 1-2 column feed
- Header height: 44px minimum (COTS C02)

4-ATTRIBUTE RULE (REQUIRED):
All interactive elements must have:
- data-qid="tactic-accordion:header:{tacticId}" for headers
- data-qid="tactic-accordion:technique:{techId}" for technique items
- data-qs-action="TOGGLE_TACTIC" / "SELECT_TECHNIQUE"
- title attribute for accessibility
- useRegisterAction for keyboard navigation

tasks.title: Integrate accordion into ThreatMatrix with breakpoint switch
tasks.prompt:
Add viewport-aware rendering to ThreatMatrix.

In Grid component:
- If isMobile || isTablet: render <TacticAccordion />
- Else: render 9-column grid (existing)

tasks.title: Create TechniqueDrawer for mobile detail view
tasks.gate: Reference drawer/slide-over patterns in existing SPARTA components
tasks.prompt:
Create side drawer for mobile technique details ("Z-Axis Shift").

File: packages/ux-lab/src/components/sparta/shared/TechniqueDrawer.tsx

REFERENCE: ThreatMatrix.Detail panel for content structure, adapt for mobile drawer

Drawer slides from right, backdrop blur, COTS C02 touch targets.

4-ATTRIBUTE RULE (REQUIRED):
All interactive elements must have:
